run.machine: 16 threads, release build, files in the page cache (CPU model not recorded)
run.method: task bench (examples/bench.rs): a generated Data directory with one base master of 400,000 records, three masters of 40,000, mods of 50 to 20,000 records and BSAs for one mod in four; median of 5 to 7 runs. libloot 0.29.7 (the Rust crate at opt-level 3, load_plugins then sort_plugins) was timed on the same directories and gave the same order for all three sizes. loot-rs times the whole api::sort call, which also evaluates the masterlist, checksums and generated messages; libloot's time is the plugin load and the sort only.
